entries.answer: Insufficient evidence: this round has not obtained a nationally comparable wage distribution for the China postsecondary teaching assistant occupation. The 2025 precise occupation annual median is 42910 US dollars; the 2023 historical percentiles and industry annual averages are a different period, and no hourly wage was published, so no figures are created by dividing by 2080. The historical Suzhou monthly figure no higher than 500 yuan is limited to one school and one round of student stipends, and the Shanghai Jiao Tong University hourly pay for that year was not checked; wages, stipends, awards, and payment months must not be mixed. China education industry urban unit pre-tax annual average wages in 2025: 133,539 yuan per year for non-private and 63,908 yuan per year for private, with the two unit types counted separately in aggregate and not combined into a personal wage range. They cover legal-person units with 5 or more persons employed in urban areas, exclude self-employed individuals and freelancers, and include personal income tax, social insurance, and housing fund deductions; this is only unit employment wage background when the actual employer belongs to the education industry and does not automatically equate graduate campus post stipends, awards and aid, or assistant title pay with statistical employee wages. This is not the median, starting pay, campus monthly stipend cap, or personal class-hour charge net income for the postsecondary teaching assistant occupation, and it does not fill the gap for a precise national distribution and current job quotes.

description.text: Postsecondary teaching assistants support postsecondary teachers or other teaching staff, prepare teaching materials and answers, organize discussion and question sessions, assist with exams and check assignments and records, and may support laboratories or research; specific subject tasks, grading standards, data use, and laboratory training are confirmed with the school and teaching team. This page fixes O*NET-SOC25-9044.00 and does not merge regular school or special education assistants. The BLS occupation description states that graduate students who independently teach one or more complete courses should be classified under the 25-1000 postsecondary teacher group, and all TA, RA, or China assistant titles cannot be directly merged into this page's statistics. China graduate assistants are a specific system with training, selection, guided training, and post stipend requirements, distinguished from teacher employee wages and other awards and aid. Paper work only checks the given rules and explanations and does not prove real teaching effectiveness or grant authority over independent courses, official grade approval, or laboratory operation.
